changelog:
- Initial release of the git-filter-repo-remove-file skill.
- Provides a step-by-step guide to permanently remove files from all Git repository history using git filter-repo.
- Includes recommendations for backing up repositories and revoking compromised secrets.
- Offers troubleshooting tips for common issues following a history rewrite.
- Instructions address scenarios like removing sensitive data, large files, and ensuring all collaborators are informed of history changes.
